job_title: Head of AI & Data Strategy and Transformation
role_summary: Leads enterprise-wide AI & Data agenda, managing strategy, portfolio, investment prioritization, value realization, and executive communications. Orchestrates cross-functional alignment across business, technology, risk, and regional teams.
must_have_requirements: 10+ years experience in strategy, transformation, consulting, portfolio management, enterprise program leadership, digital, data or AI
Experience translating ambiguous business needs into clear plans, roadmaps, and decisions
Ability to work across business, technology, risk, finance and regional stakeholders
nice_to_have_requirements: Exposure to AI, data, analytics, digital transformation or operating model design

scoring_criteria.name: AI/Data Strategy Experience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core responsibility involves developing and maintaining AI & Data strategy and roadmap.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Led AI or data strategy development
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: May lack specific AI domain expertise

scoring_criteria.name: Portfolio Management Discipline
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Requires maintaining consolidated view, prioritization, and trade-off facilitation across competing demand.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: May lack formal portfolio management tools, but process understanding is key

scoring_criteria.name: Executive Communication & Reporting
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Prepares updates, dashboards, and materials for CEO, SMT, Board, and regulators.

scoring_criteria.name: Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Alignment
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Coordinates across business, technology, risk, finance, and regional teams.

scoring_criteria.name: Transformation & Change Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Establishes operating rhythm, drives adoption, and supports change initiatives.

scoring_criteria.name: Structured Problem Solving & Ambiguity
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Translates ambiguous business needs into clear plans and senior-level decisions.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Turned vague requirements into actionable plans

scoring_criteria.name: Business Case & Value Realization
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Develops executive proposals, business cases, and benefits tracking frameworks.

scoring_criteria.name: Financial Services Experience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Preferred context; understanding of regulatory and risk environment aids credibility.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Likely gap if candidate lacks FS background

scoring_criteria.name: Leadership & Experience Level
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Requires 10+ years and ability to lead without formal authority over delivery teams.

scoring_criteria.name: Digital/AI Exposure
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Strongly preferred to understand AI/ data landscape.

do_not_overclaim: Do not claim ownership of data platform standards, data architecture or governance controls
Do not claim ownership of AI platform technical controls, observability or model lifecycle
Do not claim technology delivery or data science engineering roles

cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Position yourself as a strategic orchestrator who bridges business ambitions and technology execution, with a focus on portfolio discipline and value realization
bridge_gaps_honestly: If lacking financial services experience, emphasize transferable skills in regulated industries or complex stakeholder environments
If lacking deep AI technical background, emphasize strategic and portfolio expertise rather than technical depth
